question: An object is placed between the pole and focus of a concave mirror. Explain the nature of the image formed. Give reason.

options.A: The reflected rays diverge after reflection and appear to meet behind the mirror. Therefore, the image is virtual, erect and magnified.
options.B: The reflected rays actually meet in front of the mirror. Therefore, the image is real, inverted and diminished.
options.C: The image is formed at the centre of curvature and is real, inverted and of the same size.
options.D: The image is virtual, inverted and diminished because the object lies between the pole and focus.
